name: Tyrant
summary: Tirana is one of the cheapest capitals in Europe, with sunny Mediterranean summers and a booming cafe and coworking scene around the Blloku neighborhood. Nomads from EU countries can enter visa-free for up to 90 days, and the cost of living is a fraction of that in Western Europe. On the other hand, the city does not have its own beach (the nearest coast, Durrës, is a 40-minute drive away) and the quality of urban infrastructure still lags behind other European capitals.
